meta.source: Expressive system board (approved) + apps/swarm-desktop theme.rs and ui/tokens.rs; palettes by material-color-utilities TonalSpot (spec 2021)

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action of a view (Send, Start task, Approve), the selected segment, switches on, progress, focus rings. Fill with on-primary content.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: The New task button and other tonal emphasis that must stand out from secondary-container. Text: on-primary-container.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions on inverse-surface (a link inside a snackbar or tooltip).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting fills that are not the main action. Rare: prefer secondary-container.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Selection: the selected sidebar row, selected chip, toggled icon button, tonal buttons (Resume, Hand off). Text: on-secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Waiting for you: the attention dot of a task row, the Steer action, decision panels' accent. Never decoration.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Counters that need the owner (Inbox badge), the attention strip above the composer. Text: on-tertiary-container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Stop, danger actions, Failed, Lost and Unknown states, deleted lines' sign. Text on surfaces passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error (the Stop button's square).

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners and failed cards. Text: on-error-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main area's card (conversation, pages). Text: on-surface, on-surface-variant.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backgrounds behind scrims in light themes.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: The brightest surface in dark themes: hovered menus over dark containers.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Filled inputs inside a container card; the deepest well in light themes.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: The composer card, code blocks, tool rows at rest.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: The window ground under the sidebar and around the main card; menus and popovers.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the right pane's cards, segmented-button tracks, filled text fields.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Switch tracks off, the highest nesting (a card inside a dialog).

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, inactive icons, row metadata. 4.5:1 on every surface level.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Boundaries that must read (text field outline, switch outline off). 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Dividers, chip and outlined-button borders, card hairlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs at the scrim opacity.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow color of elevation levels.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary as text or an icon on a surface (a text button, a link, a selected icon). Equals primary where primary already passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: add
tokens.usage: Added lines' sign and +N counts. 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: del-container
tokens.usage: Deleted lines' background in diffs; the sign uses error.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Neon and Matrix only: the glow color; the composer's main action draws it as glow-shadow. Transparent elsewhere.

tokens.name: lift-ring
tokens.usage: AMOLED and Matrix only: the 1-DIP ring that replaces shadows on true black. Transparent elsewhere.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2 DIP solid, 2 DIP outside the control. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: overlay-border
tokens.usage: Dark themes: the 1-DIP edge of menus and popovers, which share surface-container with the window ground. Transparent in light themes.

families.sans: Roboto, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title-medium

styles.name: title-small

styles.usage: Answers, messages, descriptions, the composer and every text field.

styles.name: body-small

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, segments, sidebar rows, menu items, tabs, work-log steps.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Section labels, status words, the decision panel's kind line.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: A row's +/− and age.

styles.usage: Part of Google's scale; not used by the desktop today.

styles.usage: Part of Google's scale; not used by the desktop today.

styles.usage: Part of Google's scale; not used by the desktop today.

styles.name: title-medium-emphasized

styles.name: body-large-emphasized
styles.usage: Part of Google's scale; not used by the desktop today.

styles.name: body-medium-emphasized
styles.usage: A selected row in a content list.

styles.name: body-small-emphasized
styles.usage: Part of Google's scale; not used by the desktop today.

styles.name: label-large-emphasized
styles.usage: Primary-action buttons (filled), New task, the selected sidebar row, the selected menu item.

styles.name: label-medium-emphasized
styles.usage: Part of Google's scale; not used by the desktop today.

styles.name: label-small-emphasized
styles.usage: Badges and counters.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, command cards, diffs. The one size off Google's scale: an 80-column diff line plus gutter fits the 720 column at 13, not at 14.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Paths and ids inside running text.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Stacked text lines; the half step.

tokens.name: space-chip-gap
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip or small button.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Inside a group: between chips, a glyph and its label; the sidebar gutter.

tokens.name: space-row
tokens.usage: A row's inset inside its pill; icon to label in rows.

tokens.name: space-inset
tokens.usage: The content inset of a control, card or menu.

tokens.name: space-text-inset
tokens.usage: Text inset of tabs, suggestion cards and message bubbles.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: The conversation's side padding; page padding.

tokens.name: space-home-gap
tokens.usage: Between the Home title, suggestions and composer.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: The main area's side padding; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-field-leading
tokens.usage: The leading padding of WinUI's text field template.

tokens.name: radius-extra-small
tokens.usage: Tooltips, snackbars, split-button inner corners, a bubble's tail corner.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Chips, segments' inner corners, every pressed button and icon button, the composer action and New task while pressed.

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Cards, tool rows, menus, popovers, code blocks, text fields; the composer action and New task at rest; a toggled icon button.

tokens.name: radius-extra-large
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the main card, the composer card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every button, icon button, row, badge and switch at rest: half the height.

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Check boxes keep Material 3's 2-DIP container corner.

shadow.note: Light themes use the board's light opacities, dark themes its dark ones; AMOLED and Matrix replace shadows with a 1-DIP ring.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Level 1: the main card on the window ground, a pressable under the pointer, the composer at rest.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Level 2: menus, popovers, the model picker.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Level 4: a dragged row or card (Google's dragged elevation).

tokens.name: glow-shadow
tokens.usage: The composer's main action only: Neon 12 DIP, Matrix 10 DIP; none elsewhere.

opacity.note: Material 3 state layers: the content color over its container.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus state layer, together with the focus ring.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state layer and the ripple's peak (Google: 10%).

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: A disabled control's text and icon (on-surface).

tokens.name: plot-stub-opacity
tokens.usage: The stub a monitor chart draws for an unknown sample.

size.note: Desktop density: Google's sizes where they fit 32–36, the owner's numbers elsewhere (see Density).

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Every list, sidebar, menu, tree and work-log row (Google: 56; the owner's density wins).

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Every button, segmented button and split button (Material 3 Expressive XS).

tokens.name: size-icon-button
tokens.usage: An icon button's visual (Expressive XS); its target is size-target.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Chips and composer pickers (Google's chip height).

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Standalone text fields and search (Google: 56; the owner's density wins).

tokens.name: size-composer-action
tokens.usage: The composer's main action (Material 3 S icon button, square).

tokens.name: size-new-task
tokens.usage: The New task button (Material 3 S button, square).

tokens.name: size-send-menu
tokens.usage: The menu half of the composer action (▾, Add as a note).

tokens.name: size-split-menu
tokens.usage: The menu part of a split button.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Every icon in rows, buttons, icon buttons and menus (Google's desktop optical size).

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: A standalone icon button's pointer target around its 32 visual (Google: a 20 icon may use a 40 target with mouse and keyboard).

tokens.name: size-target-min
tokens.usage: The smallest pointer target: an icon button inside a 32 row. Visuals stay 8 DIP apart.

tokens.name: size-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, drawn 2 DIP outside the control.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: The idle dot of a row.

tokens.name: size-dot-wait
tokens.usage: The waiting-for-you dot of a row.

tokens.name: size-loader
tokens.usage: The shape loader in chips and buttons.

tokens.name: size-loader-lg
tokens.usage: The shape loader on an empty page.

tokens.name: size-ring
tokens.usage: The composer's context ring and quota rings.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: The sidebar and the Settings navigation.

tokens.name: size-pane
tokens.usage: The right pane at its normal width (Wide: size-reading).

tokens.name: size-form-row
tokens.usage: A form row: its label and its 32-DIP control.

tokens.name: size-two-line-row
tokens.usage: A picker or list row with a supporting line under its title.

tokens.name: size-stop-mark
tokens.usage: The drawn Stop square in the composer's action and in rows.

tokens.name: size-ring-sm
tokens.usage: A quota ring in lists (Models & Usage, Settings).

tokens.name: size-ring-stroke
tokens.usage: The stroke of every usage and quota ring.

tokens.name: size-status-stroke
tokens.usage: The outline of a hollow status mark.

tokens.name: size-popover-rise
tokens.usage: How far a popover or menu rises into place while it fades in.

spring.note: The Material 3 Expressive springs: damping ratio, stiffness, and the period Composition's natural motion takes (2π / √stiffness).

easing.note: Fallback curves for XAML storyboards until springs are available.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized
tokens.usage: Fallback for spatial springs: moves and morphs.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized-decelerate
tokens.usage: Fallback for things entering: popovers, menus, the right pane.

duration.note: Settle times of the Material 3 Expressive springs, used as durations by CSS and storyboards.

tokens.name: spatial-fast-ms
tokens.usage: Press morphs of buttons, switches and segments (spring 0.6 · 800).

tokens.name: spatial-ms
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and the right pane moving into place (spring 0.8 · 380).

tokens.name: effects-fast-ms
tokens.usage: State layers, color changes on hover and press (spring 1.0 · 3800).

tokens.name: effects-slow-ms
tokens.usage: Fades of dialogs and the scrim (spring 1.0 · 800).

icon.note: Material Symbols Rounded, weight 400, optical size 20.

tokens.name: icon-optical-size
tokens.usage: Google's optical size for dense desktop layouts.

tokens.name: icon-grade-light
tokens.usage: Grade on Light and Purple (dark icon on light).

tokens.name: icon-grade-dark
tokens.usage: Grade on Dark, AMOLED, Neon and Matrix (light icon on dark, Google's compensation for visual bleed).

scale.note: Press scales: the pressed size of a control as a share of its rest size.

tokens.name: scale-press
tokens.usage: Every pressable while pressed (buttons, rows, chips, cards).

glyph.note: The desktop's icons: Material Symbols Rounded code points in the shipped Eliot Symbols font (outline). A filled glyph sits at 0xF0000 + code - 0xE000. design/fonts/make_fonts.py cuts the font to exactly these.

tokens.name: glyph-file
tokens.usage: A file (an attachment, a file the answer names): description.

tokens.name: glyph-worktree
tokens.usage: A worktree (New worktree, Settings › Worktrees): alt_route.

tokens.name: glyph-hide-sidebar
tokens.usage: Hide and show the sidebar: left_panel_close and left_panel_open.
